verdict.rationale: Poke is itself an AI assistant/agent, so it occupies the MCP client role. All MCP evidence (`mcp add`, `tunnel`, connecting any MCP-compatible server, the X-Poke-User-Id header on outbound requests) describes Poke consuming external MCP servers, not serving its own tools to other agents. The probe's 'official MCP server' label points to that same client-side docs page, and there is no documented `mcp serve` mode or first-party hosted MCP endpoint, so the server axis does not apply.
